description: Recorded IEC 60870-5-102 frames that iec102 is tested against (testdata/captures/README.md). Files are byte-identical to their sources.

evidence_levels.C: independent recorded traffic, hardware origin unknown

sources.notes: Python 2 tool reading electricity meters over IEC 60870-5-102 through their optical port from a Raspberry Pi. The README lists the meters tried; "icra" is the Actaris SL762B. usr/tests/icra_201605_raw.txt is the tool's log of a reading: per message the octets and its interpretation (Catalan).
Python IEC 60870-5-102 (REE profile) implementation; its unit tests hold link frames and ASDU element octets.

files.format: Python unit test with ASDU element octets as bytearray.fromhex
files.evidence_basis: Element octets written into unit tests, kept for the coming ASDU codec (no frames).
files.operations: access key, time tags of the REE profile, integrated totals and their quality

files.format: Python unit test with frames as bytearray.fromhex
files.operations: fixed and variable frames of the link layer

files.format: Python unit test with frames as bytearray.fromhex
files.evidence_basis: Frames written into unit tests; whether they were taken from a meter is not stated.
systems: meters at link addresses 34572 and 53653 (test data)
files.operations: request of link status, its answer, reset of the remote link, an ASDU 183 confirmation

files.format: text log: "N bytes:" and the octets in hexadecimal per message, then the tool's interpretation
files.evidence_basis: The tool's log of reading the Actaris SL762B meter at ICRA through its optical port (README: meters tried, "icra" Actaris SL762B OK). A log, not a capture: it prints the meter's answers only, not the requests, and no time stamps.
systems: icra-tarifes-optic (Python 2, Raspberry Pi) as controlling station
Actaris SL762B electricity meter, link address 1, measurement point 1
files.operations: the meter's answers of one reading: the confirmation of the session start with access key (ASDU 183), confirmations of load profile requests (ASDU 123) and the integrated totals of the load profile (ASDU 11), two ACKs
files.privacy: meter readings of a research institute, no personal data
files.missing_for_verification: the requests, the time of the session, the meter firmware
